aact_snapshots.use: authoritative as-of-cutoff state; selective remote extraction via HTTP range + zip central directory (demonstrated)

chembl.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (quoted); ShareAlike: derived databases must carry same license + attribution

clinicaltrials_gov_api_v2.license: US government work, public domain in US (NLM web policies, quoted 2026-09-22)
clinicaltrials_gov_api_v2.use: schema probing + live counts ONLY, never as-of-cutoff facts (current-state leakage)

drugbank.status: EXCLUDED (proprietary license, not legally reusable for this product)

drugcentral.status: EXCLUDED until license text verifiable (page JS-gated at grounding time)

frozen_design_elements.abstention: model must abstain on reason-missing/unclear, ambiguous mechanism mapping, or contradictory evidence; abstentions reported as first-class output
frozen_design_elements.calibration_ranking_gates: Brier + ECE on temporally held-out post-cutoff window; PR-AUC and lift@k vs both baselines; abstention coverage reported at fixed precision floors
frozen_design_elements.competing_risks: explicit outcome classes: completed-with-results / completed-no-results / terminated-by-reason-class / withdrawn / suspended / stale-unknown. Cumulative incidence per class; never binary failure-vs-success.
frozen_design_elements.controls: negative controls: withdrawn-before-enrollment trials (efficacy information impossible); positive controls: mechanism clusters with post-cutoff confirmatory success; label-noise audit: manual sample of reason classifications

historical_cutoff.note: cutoff anchored to probe-verified snapshot dates only; snapshot availability is patchy per month
historical_cutoff.verified: 2026-09-22 probe: HTTP 206, 1,829,799,788 bytes, 47-table central directory parsed

frozen_design_elements.independent_unit: NCT trial record as of cutoff; mechanism cluster = (intervention-set -> target via ChEMBL/UniProt, condition -> MONDO/MeSH) aggregated from >=1 trials; all trials in a cluster stay in the same split (no pseudo-replication); ranking unit = mechanism cluster
frozen_design_elements.mechanistic_contradiction_features: target-disease evidence conflicts, prior same-mechanism termination counts (as-of-cutoff), modality-mechanism mismatch, retraction linkage; sources: UniProt (CC BY 4.0), MONDO (CC BY 4.0), ChEMBL (CC BY-SA 3.0, ShareAlike obligation documented), MeSH browse terms (public domain)
frozen_design_elements.missing_reason_policy: missing whyStopped = its own class 'reason-missing', never imputed; missing results = 'results-unposted' state, NEVER efficacy-failure evidence; UNKNOWN overall_status = stale cohort tracked separately; withdrawn-before-enrollment cannot carry efficacy information
frozen_design_elements.reason_taxonomy: whyStopped free text -> frozen rule-based classes: efficacy-or-futility / safety / business-or-sponsor / enrollment-or-accrual / operational-or-logistic / regulatory-hold / other / unclear(abstain). Rules versioned in code; sample-audited; unclear always abstains
simple_baselines: phase-wise transition priors from published literature (PubMed-grounded, PMIDs in ledger)
snapshot-empirical base rates per outcome class
frozen logistic baseline on phase/sponsor-type/year features
frozen_design_elements.stop_condition: STOP pre-model if (a) any post-cutoff dated content found inside the cutoff snapshot (leakage), or (b) whyStopped fill < 70% in the R1 cohort, or (c) cutoff/validation snapshots become unavailable
frozen_design_elements.temporal_outcome: typed post-cutoff events observable between cutoff and validation snapshots: results-posted, termination-recorded, withdrawal, publication-linked (study_references), retraction-recorded, resumption. Never a single collapsed 'failure' label.

notes: R0 verdict (GO/NO-GO) issued after gate evaluation; stop condition applies throughout R1+
operational_user: translational pharmacology team deciding which failed clinical mechanisms deserve manual repurposing review
product_scope: review priority only, never treatment advice
project: SP-006 (DOC-2-069 Drug Failure as Information), Round 0: open-data feasibility + grounding

r0_gates.G1_access: CT.gov API v2 + AACT snapshot access demonstrated, including selective in-zip table extraction
r0_gates.G2_cutoff: cutoff + validation snapshots probe-verified (HTTP 206 + central directory parse)
r0_gates.G3_taxonomy: overallStatus taxonomy enumerated with live counts; whyStopped fill >= 70% in a >=100-sample of TERMINATED drug studies
r0_gates.G4_licenses: every planned source has a live-quoted open license or is explicitly excluded
r0_gates.G5_linkage: publication + retraction linkage demonstrated from as-of-cutoff artifacts (study_references/retractions tables, referencesModule)
r0_gates.G6_design_frozen: all frozen design elements written into this protocol before any outcome inspection
r0_gates.G7_operational_plan: commercial workflow + safety/regulatory + provenance + monitoring + rollback + measured-cost plan written (report section)

r0_gates_locked_before: any post-cutoff outcome data inspection, cohort construction, or model work
